notes.title: Series-wide updates!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

I’m happy to announce that I’ve rolled out some minor but useful quality of life patches for all my finished games. Especially since a lot of people who played Memoirs are looking into my older (and even less polished) work :D.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/819780/The_Singularity_Wish/]The Singularity Wish [/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36102223/0cfdb633d4ec925ed3528a1197d66a1de838ec33.jpg[/img]

This is my first commercial game and you can tell it was where I learned a lot of the basics. I re-played it recently and was actually pleasantly surprised by how much I like it! Revisiting old games you've made is actually a really neat experience. Reminds me of when I used to write short stories. 

In the patch I’ve added a cheat mode and rebalanced the methods needed to achieve the best endings. One thing that’s always bothered me is how hard it was to achieve some of the rarer endings in this game, so I finally went back and made is slightly easier (or much easier if you use the cheats).

A reminder that this game’s endings are all semi-canon, which is cryptically explained in the sequel, Singularity: Tactics Arena.  

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/962220/Singularity_Tactics_Arena/]Singularity: Tactics Arena[/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36102223/fce0b3751b4febf14783624b35124cb738c2c788.jpg[/img]

S:TA is probably my first "real game." It also probably has the narrative I'm most proud of (Memoirs had a lot of problems stemming from how non-linear it is). I definitely plan on bringing back some of the characters here but like I said before, since Memoirs and most of the games I have planned are prequels, the timeline has to "catch up."

For the patch I added a pixel perfect mode, which is similar to some of the lossless applications I know some players are using to run the game.

It will make the game look sharper overall but also introduce more visual artifacts and errors.

Some people may prefer it over the default look.

You can find it in the options!


[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1177380/Memoirs_of_a_Battle_Brothel/]Memoirs of a Battle Brothel [/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36102223/c8be6bba63076ef4c2bf4587bb789634e2dad4ff.jpg[/img]

My most commercially successful game! Memoirs has a special place in my heart and so do the characters. I intend to bring them all back in Vampire Syndicate, given enough time. I am especially interested in fleshing out some characters that didn't get too much screentime. 

The patch also adds pixel perfect mode, but I also fixed some various typos and minor bugs. 


[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2610440/Baldrs_Squid_Isekai_A_Parody/]Baldr’s Squid Isekai[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36102223/c6bf4bcd89c3f042ea789883f855c067ff728d3b.jpg[/img]

Next on my to-do list is the April update for Baldr’s Squid Isekai, the stealth sequel for Memoirs. I’m excited as the next update will include a lot of new content :D.

That’s it, thanks for playing my games and as always, I appreciate your feedback.

notes.title: Thank you
notes.content:
We have launched! I want to thank all my supporters and especially my backers on Kickstarter and beta/EA testers for making all this possible. It has taken me well over a year to build Singularity: Tactics Arena, and I'm very proud of the final product. It may be rough in places, with a few bugs here and there, some balance issues, and cobbled together assets. All hallmarks of the solodev process, but I am very glad to have made the game I wanted to make, without cutting any corners or making any compromises.

Although my attention has switched over to my next project, which is both very similar and very different compared to S:TA, I will continue supporting this game with patches and updates as we head out from launch. My next step will be writing a game guide, although this may take some time and be released in increments, as S:TA is a surprisingly deep game. I expect to refine the system, especially since I will be using the same RPG and combat mechanics in my next project, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1177380/Memoirs_of_a_Battle_Brothel/]Memoirs of a Battle Brothel (NSFW)[/url]. 

I should remind backers that as additional thanks, they are also welcome to a free copy of Memoirs when it comes out (eventually). Memoirs of a Battle Brothel is a RPG set in the same world of S:TA, where players can explore the cyberpunk setting of MoonFall. However, the game does include various NSFW elements, due to it's theme. 

If you would like to check out my next game, keep updated on my Patreon (This link is NSFW): [url=https://www.patreon.com/amemoryofeternity]https://www.patreon.com/amemoryofeternity[/url]

Thanks again,

As I've said before, I will continue to support Singularity with regular patches and updates as needed.

notes.title: Beta Version 0.563 live for Windows!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Beta version 0.563 is now live for Windows, with a Mac version to come very soon. As promised in the last update, this version brings the game content up to 75% and adds on the Trauma system. The trauma system is a hard mode that adds permanent status modifiers and can be turned on or off by using one of the machines in the Augmentation room.

Other changes include the addition of an error log, reworking critical hits, animation fixes, rebalancing some skills and items, and several major bug fixes, including (hopefully) reducing the occurrence of the battle placement crash. 

And probably a slew of new and exciting bugs!

Also, moving forward, patches and updates will have more detailed changelogs. 

Let me know your feed back either here or on the discord: [url=https://discord.gg/azkt8RD]https://discord.gg/azkt8RD[/url]

notes.title: Roadmap to Launch
notes.content:
[b]We’re in the final stretch[/b]

Hi all, so there’s some curiosity about how the current roadmap looks, and I’m pleased to announce that we are in the final stretch to a full launch. There are a few obstacles in the way (including one rather persistent bug that affects a small section of players), but I don’t anticipate any major issues.

[b]Next Major Patch[/b]

The next major content update will bring the playable story up to 75%, introduce the Trauma system (which you can turn on and off at any point), and introduce a variety of bug fixes, optimizations and new features. The most important of which is how critical damage is handled (now scaling max crit damage to 1.7x rather than 3x+), a new function that logs crash errors and more. I expect this patch to be available sometime next week.

[b]Final Beta Version[/b]

Following the release of this patch, I will be preparing the final beta version, which will include 100% of the story content and a general polish absent from the current beta. This is anticipated for the end of October.

[b]Launch[/b]

After this final beta version, I will continue receiving feedback until the game reaches the level of quality and stability where I believe it will be ready for launch. I am hoping for the full launch out of Early Access to occur sometime in early November. 

In the meantime, keep me updated with your thoughts and feedback! Thanks again,

notes.title: Early Access/Open Beta begins tomorrow
notes.content:
It's finally here! Early Access will begin tomorrow. 

[b]Why Early Access?[/b]

“We are nearing the end of development for Singularity: Tactics Arena. Our early access period is essentially an open beta. We are hoping that player feedback will help us fine-tune the game and remove any bugs. The Early Access version of Singularity: Tactics Arena is a little over 50% of the game’s total content, so the EA price reflects that.”

[b]Approximately how long will this game be in Early Access?[/b]

“We predict the game will be in Early Access until late November, at which point the official release will be launched.”

[b]How is the full version planned to differ from the Early Access version?[/b]

“A more content-complete, bug-free experience with several features (which are now missing) fully implemented. In particular:

The story content as of Beta version 0.559 is only 50%. As the game is developed through Early Access, the amount of story content will increase incrementally.

The Trauma system, which afflicts characters with certain status effects as a consequence of the trauma they suffer through combat, is not currently implemented but planned for the full game.

Various graphics and animations are currently using placeholders, which will disappear as development continues.

Class levels past 15 are still under development and not fully stable/ready to be used.

A multitude of bugs that will be fixed as development continues.
”
[b]What is the current state of the Early Access version?[/b]

“The current version, BETA 0.558, covers over 50% of the game by content. Nearly all the features listed under the Features section is complete, except for:

Story content is under development, meaning only half of the 20 levels are playable so far.

Trauma system is still under development.
”
[b]Will the game be priced differently during and after Early Access?[/b]

“Yes. The Early Access price reflects the game’s stage in development. Upon full release, this will be increased to match the completed game's value.”

[b]How are you planning on involving the Community in your development process?[/b]

“Yes. This game is mostly a one-man project. I would love to hear suggestions, bug catches and other feedback. Join us at our discord discussion: https://discord.gg/azkt8RD or right here on Steam in the community forums.”

notes.title: Update: Windows BETA is Ready, Mac Version Coming Very Soon
notes.content:
Hi all,
 
Great news, the closed beta for windows is ready on both Steam and Itch.io. The Mac version is postponed slightly due to some technical issues, which may require me buying a new Mac to fix. 
 
If you want a beta key, contact me on my discord channel here: [url=https://discord.gg/azkt8RD]https://discord.gg/azkt8RD[/url]. Got 100 spare keys so it's first come first serve.
 
What you should expect from the Beta:
 
[list]
[*] The first phase of the Beta will cover the first full 1/3 of the game. As the test period progresses, I will update the Beta until it covers 100% of the game, and eventually, towards full release. I am attempting to do this in such a way where testers can download new files and pick up where they left off, with all of their progress intact, when an update drops, but bugs may occur.

[*] There is currently no hard level cap. Players may level up their characters all the way to the soft cap of level 20 (after which no new features, skills or non-stat benefits appear). Leveling past that will result in stat bonuses.
 
[*] All items will be available for sale in the shop early in the game. This may not persist into the final build, and prices will change.

[*] This is a Beta, so there can be any number of bugs, glitches, typos, etc. I have not identified any game breaking bugs yet, but they may exist. 

[*] Some placeholder graphics/UI/animations, etc. If something looks a bit odd or unfinished, it may be a placeholder.

[*] Combat should be intuitive for players accustomed to turn-based RPGs, but details are available in-game through the journal. 
 
[*] Yet-to-be implemented features. The most notable of which is the Trauma System.

[/list]

notes.title: The Beta is Finished, Closed Testing Period Coming Soon
notes.content:
Good news everyone! The first phase of the Beta has been completed and I’m getting ready to launch the closed testing period. What remains is a few administrative/technical tasks, such as uploading the beta to Steam and Itch.io as well as generating keys. I’m planning on creating keys for both Steam and Itch.io for Windows and macOS, but can’t guarantee they will come out at the same time. I am currently aiming for the week of August 26th as the Beta launch date. 

[b]What can you expect from the Beta?[/b]

The first phase of the Beta will cover the first, full 1/3 of the game. As the test period progresses, I will update the Beta until it covers 100% of the game, at which point the game will go into full release. I am attempting to do this in such a way where testers can download new files and pick up where they left off, with all of their progress intact, when an update drops, but bugs may occur.

There is currently no hard level cap. Players may level up their characters all the way to the soft cap of level 20 (after which no new features, skills or non-stat benefits appear). Leveling past that will result in stat bonuses.

This is a Beta, so there can be any number of bugs, glitches, typos, etc. I have not identified any game breaking bugs yet, but they may exist. Some placeholder graphics/UI/animations, etc. If something looks a bit odd or unfinished, it may be a placeholder. There are also some yet-to-be implemented features. The most notable of which is the Trauma System.

Thanks again for your continued support! I’m excited to finally launch this project out into the wider world. For all its faults and rough edges, I really hope the experience - especially the story - holds up. I think we’re in for a wild ride.
